You confirmed the owner followed the "original factory schedule" which resulted in **no CVT fluid changes** despite the 2016 Altima having over 83,000 miles. Purchasing this car at $11,500 requires me to assume the risk of a catastrophic transmission failure. Based on the mileage and lack of service, I must budget for an immediate full CVT flush or unit replacement. The cost for a Toyota/Nissan CVT unit and installation is approximately **$3,500**.

Per my negotiation terms, I must deduct the full repair cost from the average market value.

**Math: KBB Average ($11,765) - CVT Replacement Cost ($3,500) = $8,265.**

The realistic value of this car as it stands is **$8,000**. I can meet you at a mutually convenient location to close the deal this week if you agree.
